realistic.name: Realistic type
realistic.description: You prefer hands-on, practical work and enjoy using tools and machines to build or fix things. I like manual activities where concrete results are visible.
realistic.workEnvironment: Real-world, hands-on environments such as workshops, construction sites, laboratories or outdoors. We excel when we work with tools, machines, and tangible projects.

investigative.name: Exploratory type
investigative.description: You enjoy analyzing problems, researching, and working with ideas. I enjoy intellectual challenges and like understanding the principles of how things work.
investigative.workEnvironment: Research facility, laboratory, library or academic environment. They prefer an environment where they can engage in quiet, intellectual activities with minimal disruption.

artistic.name: art type
artistic.description: You are creative and self-expressive and enjoy playing with ideas, colors, language or shapes. I value originality and enjoy an environment where creative expression is possible.
artistic.workEnvironment: Creative studio, theatre, gallery or flexible workspace. You need the freedom to be creative at your own pace.

social.name: social type
social.description: You enjoy helping, teaching, and working with people. I am attracted to activities that care for others and have a positive impact on their lives.
social.workEnvironment: School, hospital, community center or counseling office. You excel in an environment where you can focus on helping and communicating with people.

enterprising.name: Enterprising type
enterprising.description: You enjoy leading, persuading, and organizing others to achieve goals. You enjoy a competitive environment and are good at taking risks and making decisions.
enterprising.workEnvironment: Business office, sales floor or leadership position. Stand out in a competitive, results-driven environment.

conventional.name: customary type
conventional.description: You prefer a structured, orderly work environment with clear procedures. Excellent at organizing data, managing details, and following established systems.
conventional.workEnvironment: Office, bank, government agency or organized organization. Prefer environments with clear hierarchies and predictability.
